hoSoTuVan._doc: 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk nhom NHU CAU / TU VAN 03/09 + 06/09): HO SO TU VAN cua nganh — tang 1 (packages/brain engine/consult-profile.ts) chi hoi cac cau chon hang cua mot nhu cau khi khach CHUA goi dich danh mau va nhu cau thuoc nhom CHUYEN MON; moi thong tin hoi toi da MOT lan trong phien; nhu cau PHO THONG thi goi y theo nhom pho thong, khong hoi ho so. Moi bieu thuc chay tren chu DA BO DAU, chu thuong. `nhom[].kieu`: chuyen-mon (can ho so, nhac o dau trong phien cung THANG pho thong) | pho-thong (tra kho theo `mucDich`). `nhomHang`: nhan nhom hang cua landing — tu doi thuong lay tu cham-diem.json nhomHang.biDanh, KHONG khai lai. `truong[]`: `doc` = khach da cho (chu khop la dieu khach noi), `hoi` = mot CAU HOI ve truong nay (de biet page da hoi chua, va cong soat cat cau hoi lai), `batBuoc`=false thi chi hoi khi tien, `tuPhanTich` = khoa needBrief cua LLM#1, `maTran` = truc ma tran cua line-dna.json. `suyRa[]`: chu khach noi (khi, tru dau hieu nguoc) → coi nhu da biet truong (`maTran` = dai cua ma tran). `boTruoc`: bo size + so tien truoc khi doc ("500k" la tien, "size 42" khong phai cu ly).
